name: fig_intercept_error.jpg
caption: Recorded mean squared error (MSE) for candidate intercept corrections b = 0, 1.5, and 3 evaluated deterministically on the five synthetic observations. Text labels indicate the exact recorded (b, MSE) coordinate pairs.

name: fig_residual_workflow.jpg
caption: Schematic workflow of the finite intercept correction on five observations. A baseline predictor 2x generates residuals r_i = y_i - 2x_i relative to targets y = 2x + 3. The sample mean residual defines the scalar correction b = 3, which is added to the baseline to produce corrected predictions 2x + b evaluated in-sample across the same observations.
